## 3. Surgical Procedures & Evidence-Based Pathways

### Total Knee Replacement (TKR)
- Hindi Title: टोटल नी रिप्लेसमेंट (पूर्ण घुटना प्रत्यारोपण - TKR)
- Category: Joint Replacement | Hospital Stay: 3–4 days
- Indications: Grade 4 tricompartmental osteoarthritis, bone-on-bone joint collapse, fixed varus/valgus angular deformities, severe rest pain disturbing sleep.
- Surgical Craft: Pre-operative digital sizing; minimal-subvastus quadriceps-sparing approach; sub-millimetre resections preserving collateral ligaments; cobalt-chromium femoral component with cross-linked polyethylene insert.
- Recovery Timeline:
  - Day 1–2: Assisted standing and walker walking initiated with physiotherapist.
  - Weeks 3–4: Transition to single elbow stick; safe stair negotiation.
  - Weeks 6–8: Independent walking without aids; return to routine daily living.

### Partial / Unicondylar Knee Replacement (UKA)
- Hindi Title: पार्शियल / यूनिकांडाइलर घुटना प्रत्यारोपण (UKA)
- Category: Joint Replacement | Hospital Stay: 1–2 days
- Indications: Isolated single-compartment (medial or lateral) osteoarthritis with intact anterior cruciate ligament (ACL) and correctable deformity.
- Surgical Craft: Keyhole mini-arthrotomy; leaves native ACL, PCL, and healthy cartilage untouched; retains natural joint proprioception.
- Recovery Timeline:
  - Day 1: Full weight-bearing within hours of surgery.
  - Weeks 2–3: Range of motion >110 degrees; walking stick discontinued.
  - Weeks 4–6: Return to active recreation, long walks, and driving.

### Total Hip Replacement (THR)
- Hindi Title: टोटल हिप रिप्लेसमेंट (पूर्ण कूल्हा प्रत्यारोपण - THR)
- Category: Joint Replacement | Hospital Stay: 3–5 days
- Indications: Advanced Avascular Necrosis (AVN Stage 3/4), secondary osteoarthritis, ankylosing spondylitis.
- Surgical Craft: Muscle-preserving exposure; ceramic delta femoral head on cross-linked polyethylene liner; anatomical limb-length restoration.
- Recovery Timeline:
  - Day 1: Assisted standing and walking initiated within 24 hours.
  - Weeks 2–4: Independent indoor mobility and stair negotiation.
  - Weeks 6–12: Complete return to active routine, long-distance walking, and driving.

### Complex Knee & Revision Joint Replacement
- Hindi Title: जटिल घुटना एवं पुनरावलोकन सर्जरी
- Category: Joint Replacement | Hospital Stay: 5–7 days
- Indications: Failed earlier implant, aseptic loosening, deep joint infection, angular deformity >20 degrees, severe bone loss.
- Surgical Craft: Careful implant extraction preserving host bone; modular stem extensions; porous titanium metal augments for bone defect reconstruction.

### Bipolar Hemiarthroplasty
- Hindi Title: बाईपोलर हेमीआर्थ्रोप्लास्टी (कूल्हा फ्रैक्चर)
- Category: Joint Replacement | Hospital Stay: 3–4 days
- Indications: Displaced intracapsular femoral neck fractures in elderly patients.
- Surgical Craft: Rapid dual-articulating prosthetic replacement preventing prolonged bed rest and recumbency complications (pneumonia, bedsores).
- Recovery Timeline: Walker walking initiated within 24–48 hours of surgery.

### Arthroscopy & ACL / PCL Reconstruction
- Hindi Title: एसीएल / पीसीएल लिगामेंट दूरबीन सर्जरी
- Category: Arthroscopy & Sports | Hospital Stay: 1–2 days
- Indications: Complete ligament rupture with rotational giving-way instability, high-demand sports activity.
- Surgical Craft: Autologous hamstring or bone-patellar tendon autograft; anatomical tunnel placement; titanium button and bioabsorbable screw fixation.
- Recovery Timeline:
  - Weeks 1–2: Crutch-assisted walking in locked extension brace.
  - Weeks 3–6: Weaning off crutches; progressive flexion to 120 degrees; stationary cycling.
  - Months 4–9: Running, agility drills, and formal sports clearance testing.

### Meniscus Repair & Preservation
- Hindi Title: मेनिस्कस दूरबीन रिपेयर (कार्टिलेज संरक्षण)
- Category: Arthroscopy & Sports | Hospital Stay: Daycare to 1 day
- Indications: Longitudinal, bucket-handle, or radial meniscus tears in red-red or red-white vascular zones.
- Surgical Craft: All-inside and inside-out micro-suturing anchors preserving natural shock-absorbing capacity.

### Shoulder Arthroscopy & Rotator Cuff Repair
- Hindi Title: कंधा आर्थ्रोस्कोपी एवं रोटेटर कफ रिपेयर
- Category: Arthroscopy & Sports | Hospital Stay: 1–2 days
- Indications: Full-thickness rotator cuff tears, subacromial impingement, recurrent shoulder dislocations (Bankart lesions), frozen shoulder.
- Surgical Craft: Subacromial decompression and bio-composite suture anchor fixation under high-definition optical arthroscopic visualization.

### Fracture Fixation (ORIF Locking Plates)
- Hindi Title: जोड़ों के जटिल फ्रैक्चर का स्थिरीकरण (ORIF)
- Category: Trauma & Fractures | Hospital Stay: 2–4 days
- Indications: Displaced articular fractures (tibial plateau, distal radius, ankle pilon, distal femur).
- Surgical Craft: Anatomical reduction under fluoroscopic C-arm control; internal fixation with low-profile titanium locking plates.

### Closed Interlocking Intramedullary Nailing
- Hindi Title: क्लोज्ड इंटरलॉकिंग नेलिंग (लंबी हड्डियों का फ्रैक्चर)
- Category: Trauma & Fractures | Hospital Stay: 2–4 days
- Indications: Midshaft femur and tibia diaphyseal fractures.
- Surgical Craft: Biological fixation preserving periosteal blood supply without opening the fracture hematoma.

### Daycare Carpal Tunnel & Trigger Finger Release
- Hindi Title: कार्पल टनल एवं ट्रिगर फिंगर रिलीज
- Category: Daycare Surgeries | Hospital Stay: 2–3 hours (Outpatient)
- Indications: Median nerve entrapment causing hand numbness and tingling; painful finger locking/snapping.
- Surgical Craft: Procedure conducted under local anesthesia; immediate decompression with outpatient discharge.

### De Quervain's Tenosynovitis Release
- Hindi Title: डी क्वेरवेन टेनोसाइनोवाइटिस रिलीज
- Category: Daycare Surgeries | Hospital Stay: Outpatient
- Indications: Severe thumb-side wrist pain failing splints and local injections.
- Surgical Craft: Complete release of the first dorsal compartment sheath while protecting radial sensory nerve branches.

---

## 4. Key Areas of Care & Diagnostic Guidelines
1. Knee Pain & Joint Care: Non-surgical cartilage protection, quadriceps kinetic chain training, viscosupplementation, unloader bracing.
2. Joint Replacement Surgeries: Primary TKR and THR engineered for precision alignment and Day-1 walking.
3. Complex Knee Revision: Structural revision for loosened implants and angular bone loss.
4. Back Pain, Spine & Lumbar Care: Conservative management of sciatica, lumbar spondylosis, and disc herniation; core stabilization.
5. Minimally Invasive Arthroscopy: Keyhole ligament and cartilage repair.
6. Shoulder & Rotator Cuff Care: Rotator cuff tear repair and frozen shoulder management.
7. Sports Injuries & Ligament Rehabilitation: Multi-ligament reconstruction and sports return protocols.
8. Fracture & Trauma Care: Biological bone fixation with locking plates and nails.
9. Rehabilitation & Mobility Restoration: Step-by-step physical therapy and long-term joint health.

## 5. Frequently Asked Questions (Bilingual Summary)

### How to book a consultation? / परामर्श कैसे बुक करें?
- Consultations can be scheduled by calling +91 97602 30687, sending a WhatsApp message, or booking online at https://drgauravsharma.clinic/en/contact or https://drgauravsharma.clinic/hi/contact.

### When is knee replacement truly required? / घुटना प्रत्यारोपण कब अनिवार्य होता है?
- Surgery is recommended only when Grade 4 bone-on-bone osteoarthritis causes permanent rest pain, waking up at night, and severe restriction in daily walking that does not respond to conservative care.

### Can joint pain be treated without surgery? / क्या बिना सर्जरी जोड़ों का इलाज संभव है?
- Yes. Over 70% of patients consulting Dr. Gaurav Sharma are successfully managed with targeted physiotherapy, lifestyle pacing, bracing, and biological injections without requiring an operation.

### What should I bring to my first visit? / पहली बार आते समय क्या साथ लाएं?
- Bring all physical X-ray films, MRI plates, blood test reports, and a list of current medications for in-person review on the viewbox.
